issues.title: Changing the sender name on order emails
issues.problem_statement: The customer asked where to change the sender name on their order emails.

items.description: Support explained that the sender name is changed under Email settings, then Sender name, by typing the brand name and saving.
evidence: Go to Email settings, then Sender name, type your brand name and save.

items.description: Customer changed the sender name to their brand name in Email settings following support's guidance, saved it, and confirmed it now shows their brand name.
evidence: It shows my brand name now.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with a clear outcome.
